VghLantern__Terms__Config.VghLantern__Terms__Config__Description: System configuration for the Terms and Conditions system. Merged over VghLantern__AppConfig__Main__.json by AppCore ConfigLoader and read back through ConfigLoader.GetSection('Terms'). Section order, section numbering, the markdown source of every standard section and the drawing QR block all live here. No clause number is ever computed anywhere but VghLantern__Terms__DocumentModel__.js, and no clause text is ever held in JS.

VghLantern__Terms__Config__Document.IntroductionText: The following terms and conditions form part of our quotation and apply to any order placed with us. Please read them in full.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__Document.EmptyStateMessage: Every terms section is switched off, so no terms document will be issued.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__Document.LibraryFailureMessage: The standard terms library could not be loaded. The terms document cannot be issued until it is available.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__Document.ReviewNoticeHeading: Note on the status of these terms
VghLantern__Terms__Config__Document.ReviewNoticeText: These terms and conditions have not yet been reviewed or approved by Vale Garden Houses' legal advisers. They are issued as a working draft to describe the intended basis of any order, and should not be relied upon as final contract wording. Approved terms will be issued before an order is confirmed.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__Document.ReviewNoticeNote: One notice at the end of the terms document, printed in the critical colour, replacing what used to be a per-clause marker on every clause. Forty-four red markers made the document unreadable and buried the point; one statement at the end makes it once, clearly. Set ReviewNoticeEnabled to false when the library has been approved - that is the whole switch, and it also stops the Preview and Send warning that accompanies it.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__Document.LibraryBasePathNote: Relative to the application root. The loader appends the SourceFile named on each section below.

VghLantern__Terms__Config__Numbering.NumberFormatNote: Tokens are {section} and {term}. The section number is fixed per section in the Sections table below and never moves. The term number is the one-based position within that section's terms.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__Numbering.TermNumberPaddingNote: Zero padding width for the term half of the number, so a section's clauses sort and align as 4.01 through 4.12 rather than 4.1 through 4.12.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__Numbering.SectionNumberPaddingNote: Zero padding width for the section half. Zero means no padding, giving 4.08 rather than 04.08.

VghLantern__Terms__Config__Sections.Label: Critical Project Terms
VghLantern__Terms__Config__Sections.Description: Project-specific terms the reader must not miss. Printed in the critical colour. Authored per project in the Client Doc tab, never from the library.

VghLantern__Terms__Config__Sections.Label: Special Project Terms
VghLantern__Terms__Config__Sections.Description: Project-specific terms that vary the standard terms below. Authored per project in the Client Doc tab.

VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingTermsD.IntroductionText: The following notes, limitations and omissions apply to every drawing issued with this quotation. Where a drawing carries notes of its own, those notes are printed immediately after that drawing and are read in addition to these.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingTermsD.EmptyStateMessage: The general drawing terms are switched off, so no drawing terms document will be issued.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingTermsD.LibraryFailureMessage: The general drawing terms library could not be loaded. The drawing terms document cannot be issued until it is available.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingTermsD.ReviewNoticeHeading: Note on the status of these drawing terms
VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingTermsD.ReviewNoticeText: These drawing terms have not yet been reviewed or approved by Vale Garden Houses' legal advisers. They are issued as a working draft to describe the intended basis on which the drawings are read, and should not be relied upon as final wording.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingTermsD.LanternIntroductionText: The following notes apply to this drawing in particular, and are read in addition to the General Drawing Terms at the back of this document.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingTermsD.LanternNote: A lantern's own drawing notes are their own one-section document, printed immediately after that lantern's sheet. The section number restarts at 1 for each lantern because these notes are cited against a drawing, not against the pack - 'note 1.03 on the Kitchen drawing' is unambiguous in a way that a pack-wide running number would not be once a lantern is added or removed.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingTermsD.DocumentNote: The drawing terms are a SEPARATE DOCUMENT from the business terms of engagement in VghLantern__Terms__Config__Document above, with their own title, their own introduction, their own numbering series and their own review notice. One is read by whoever is setting out on site, the other by whoever is signing the order. They are deliberately not sections of one another, because switching the payment terms off should have nothing to do with whether a contractor is told not to scale off a drawing.

VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingTermsS.Label: General Drawing Terms, Limitations and Omissions

VghLantern__Terms__Config.VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingTermsS: The section table for the General Drawing Terms document. Numbered in its own series starting at 1, independent of the business terms sections, because the two documents are cited separately. Add a section here to add a page to the drawing terms document; the loader picks up any SourceFile named in this table exactly as it does for the business terms.
VghLantern__Terms__Config.VghLantern__Terms__Config__SectionsNote: Number is FIXED and is what makes a clause citable. Never renumber a section to close a gap - a section switched off simply does not print, and the sections around it keep their numbers so a term quoted on a previous document still means the same clause. Source is either 'project:critical', 'project:special' or 'library' with a SourceFile. EmptyBehaviour 'hide' drops an empty section silently (a project with no special terms is normal); 'warn' raises a Preview and Send warning because an empty standard section means a missing or unreadable markdown file.

VghLantern__Terms__Config__Style.NumberColumnWidthMmNote: Width reserved at the left for the clause number. The term body is indented by this much so wrapped lines align under the first line rather than under the number.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__Style.CriticalTermColourNote: Matches --VghLantern_ErrorRed and the UserWarningColour used for staff-authored specification warnings. Critical terms and the closing review notice both print in it.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__Style.ReviewNoticeGapMmNote: Space above the closing notice, wider than the gap between sections so the notice reads as separate from the terms rather than as a seventh section.

VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingQrBloc.BlockNote: The terms cell is the right-hand cell of the titleblock strip, mirroring the logo cell at the left-hand end. It is not a separate box: it is the same height as the strip, it uses the strip's own label and value type sizes, and it is divided from the fields by the same rule as every other cell. The QR square sits inside it at the strip's height.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingQrBloc.BodyText: Use of this drawing is not authorised until all general and project-specific notes, terms, limitations and omissions have been read and fully understood. Scan the QR code or refer to the document pack for the defined responsibilities of Vale Garden Houses Ltd, the client and all contractors.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingQrBloc.TextNote: The heading prints bold in the ink colour and the body prints lighter and muted beneath it, wrapped over up to BodyMaxLines lines. This cell inverts the caption-over-value rhythm the other titleblock cells use, deliberately: the other cells caption a value the reader is looking for, whereas this one is telling them to go and read something, so the instruction leads.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingQrBloc.BodyMaxLinesNote: Wrapping stops here rather than overflowing the strip. At the default cell width and titleblock height four lines is what fits; shorten BodyText rather than raising this further unless the titleblock has also grown.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingQrBloc.TermsQrBaseUrlNote: PLACEHOLDER ADDRESS. This is the localhost development link so the code is scannable and testable today. Replace it with the hosted Vale client terms URL when the online portal exists. Changing this one key is the whole migration - no JS anywhere knows the address.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingQrBloc.TermsQrQueryPatternNote: Tokens: projectCode. VghLantern__Terms__QrLink__.js both builds this and reads it back on inbound navigation, so the link the code encodes and the link the app answers cannot drift.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingQrBloc.DrawingTermsQrQueryPatternNote: Tokens: projectCode, lanternIndex. This is what every drawing sheet encodes, because a contractor scanning a sheet wants the drawing omissions and limitations rather than the payment schedule. The code is the same whether or not that lantern has notes of its own: the application resolves it on arrival, showing the lantern's own notes where they exist and the General Drawing Terms where they do not. That way writing a lantern's first note does not invalidate a code already printed on an issued sheet. TermsQrQueryPattern above is still used for a project-level link with no lantern in scope.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingQrBloc.CellWidthMmNote: Relative share of the titleblock strip is not used here: this cell is an absolute width taken off the right-hand end, and the flexible field cells divide what is left. That keeps the QR square a fixed printed size whatever paper the sheet is on.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingQrBloc.QrPaddingMmNote: Inset above and below the code inside the strip. The printed QR edge length is the titleblock height less twice this, so the code is exactly as tall as the strip it sits in and nothing about it needs a second dimension to stay in step.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingQrBloc.QrQuietZoneModulesNote: Light margin around the symbol in modules. ISO/IEC 18004 asks for 4; 2 is used here because the cell's own white ground and the rule beside it already give the scanner most of that margin, and at this printed size every module counts.
VghLantern__Terms__Config__DrawingQrBloc.QrScanSizeNote: SIZE WARNING. At the default 10 mm titleblock height the code prints about 8.8 mm square. A version 5 symbol (37 modules, which is what a project code in the default localhost URL produces) then has a 0.24 mm module, which is below what most phone cameras resolve reliably from a printed A3 sheet. Two levers, either of which fixes it without changing any code: raise Sheet.TitleBlockHeightMm in Na__DrawingEditor__Config.json from 10 to about 16, or shorten TermsQrBaseUrl. The hosted terms URL is expected to be far shorter than the development one, which on its own drops the symbol to version 2 or 3 and roughly doubles the module size.
